basic_details.job_title: IIM Bangalore Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Two Research Associate posts at The Tony James Centre for Private Equity and Venture Capital, Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB), Bannerghatta Road, are open to a Master's graduate from a reputed institution in a field such as Economics, Corporate Finance, Statistics/Data Sciences or Entrepreneurship, with two years of research experience. The posts are hired under a Project Code. Apply through the online application link in the notice by 10 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Applications are made through the online application link given in the notice (see Important Links). All fields in the application form are mandatory. The following documents are to be uploaded while submitting the application:
Diploma/Graduation: all semester wise Marksheets and Final Diploma/Degree Certificate.
Masters/Post-Graduation: all semester wise Marksheets and Final Degree Certificate.
Applications without these documents will be treated as incomplete and will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated.

content_sections.heading: IIMB Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the pay, the age limit or the application fee.

rows.details: The Tony James Centre for Private Equity and Venture Capital
Online (application link given in the notice)

content_sections.heading: About IIMB
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Management Bangalore (IIMB) is described in the notice as a leading graduate school of management in Asia. Under the IIM Act of 2017, IIMB is an Institute of National Importance. The notice lists its industry as Higher Education.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives one post, Research Associate, with the following requirements. Two years of experience performing research and preparing reports. Experience of using statistical tools is a must. Understanding of financial models is desirable. Some experience in a research or educational institution is preferable but not mandatory. Knowledge of econometric models and methods will be preferred though not mandatory. Excellent oral and written communication skills. Ability to work independently. Superior analytical skills, ensuring accuracy and adherence to academic standards. Motivation to learn and a strong work ethic. Excellent problem-solving and multi-tasking skills. The position is best suited for a candidate with interest in pursuing a Ph.D. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's graduate from a reputed Institution in any field such Economics or Corporate Finance or Statistics/ Data Sciences or Entrepreneurship with strong quantitative research background.

content_sections.heading: Job Type and Reporting
content_sections.text: The Research Associate will be hired under a Project Code and will report to the Chair Professor for Private Equity and Venture Capital. The two positions are at IIMB, Bannerghatta Road.

content_sections.heading: IIMB Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Job purpose: assist in ongoing research projects at the Tony James Center, including primary and secondary data collection, analysis with appropriate statistical and econometric tools, and assist in writing papers generation in accordance with the project charter. Principal accountabilities and responsibilities: Assist in ongoing research projects. Comfortable in working with large and multiple datasets. Collect secondary data from databases, database management including scrapping of data from websites and collection of primary data through surveys, questionnaires, etc. Work on statistical tools such as R/Stata/SQL and MS Excel for data analysis. Knowledge of econometric models and methods will be preferred though not mandatory. Assist in literature review and writing of both academic and white papers and also case-studies. Create research summaries in multiple formats, including spreadsheets, PowerPoint presentations, graphs, written summaries. Beyond research and publications, the candidate may be required to provide administrative and academic support, including organizing meetings, workshops, and research discussions. Ensuring smooth execution of academic initiatives and providing logistical support for Centre events will also be part of the candidate's responsibility. Perform other related duties for the Tony James Center as assigned.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIMB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made through the online application link given in the notice (see Important Links). All fields in the application form are mandatory. The following documents are to be uploaded while submitting the application: 10th and 12th Marksheets. Diploma/Graduation: all semester wise Marksheets and Final Diploma/Degree Certificate. Masters/Post-Graduation: all semester wise Marksheets and Final Degree Certificate. Applications without these documents will be treated as incomplete and will not be considered. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts are there in IIMB?
faq.answer: The notice lists two positions at IIMB, Bannerghatta Road, for Research Associate at The Tony James Centre for Private Equity and Venture Capital.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIMB Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: The closing date for applications is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IIMB Research Associate?
faq.answer: The candidate should be a Master's graduate from a reputed Institution in any field such Economics or Corporate Finance or Statistics/ Data Sciences or Entrepreneurship with strong quantitative research background.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Two years of experience performing research and preparing reports is required, and experience of using statistical tools is a must.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill out the online application using the link given in the notice, complete all mandatory fields and upload the listed marksheets and certificates.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must be uploaded?
faq.answer: 10th and 12th marksheets, all semester-wise marksheets and the final Diploma/Degree certificate for Diploma/Graduation, and all semester-wise marksheets and the final Degree certificate for Masters/Post-Graduation.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if documents are missing?
faq.answer: Applications without the required documents will be treated as incomplete and will not be considered.

faq.question: Q8. Under which arrangement will the Research Associate be hired?
faq.answer: The notice says the Research Associate will be hired under a Project Code and will report to the Chair Professor for Private Equity and Venture Capital.

faq.question: Q9. Will every applicant be contacted?
faq.answer: No. Only shortlisted candidates will be intimated.
